main_text.head: AD HENRICVM III. Nauarræ Regem.
main_text.p: ANTIQVA Regum progenies, decus Illustre Gentis Borbonicæ, cui Lucescit inter clariores Conspicuum caput vsque Gallos: Quo te celebrem carmine? qua Lyra Dicam benigni robora pectoris Inuicta? quo iusti tenacem Proposití resonare tentem Heroa plectro: quem popularium Non terret ardor praua iubentium, Iraeque Magnatum, nec arma Sanguinea sociata turbæ? Quem non profanis, quæ rotat arcibus Romanus atrox fulmina Pontifex, Nec feruor instantis pericli Mente quatit solida pauentem? Immota rupes sic manet ictibus Vtcunque raucis vnda furens petat: Quum miscet insanis patentem Æolus Oceanum procellis. Milesne tantum perdere principem

page.notes: The ornamental initial A is a woodcut and is joined to the word "ANTIQVA". Line "Milésne" has an accent over the e as printed. Some words are doubtful in the scan and may contain print damage; the running head is absent.
